title: Seat-count sources
description: data/sources.yaml: every source a chamber's seat counts can come from.

id.description: Stable identifier that chamber files reference in their `source` field. Never change it once published.

name.description: Shown as the credit next to the seats. When the source prescribes the wording of its credit, use it verbatim.

url.description: The documented open-data endpoint or dataset page the seat counts are read from.

citation.description: What the source is and how seat counts are derived from it.

license.description: Name of the licence or terms of use the source publishes its data under.

license_url.description: Where that licence or those terms can be read.
